title: MP GK & General Studies — Practice Test 1
description: 20 mixed questions on MP GK, science, computer, reasoning and English — the pattern used in MP ESB exams.

questions.q: What is the capital of Madhya Pradesh?
questions.solution:
Bhopal is the capital of Madhya Pradesh. Indore is the largest city by population.
भोपाल मध्य प्रदेश की राजधानी है।

questions.q: Madhya Pradesh was formed on which date?
questions.solution:
Madhya Pradesh was formed on 1 November 1956 under the States Reorganisation Act. On 1 November 2000, Chhattisgarh was carved out of it.
मध्य प्रदेश का गठन 1 नवंबर 1956 को हुआ।

questions.q: Which river is called the 'lifeline of Madhya Pradesh'?
questions.solution:
The Narmada rises at Amarkantak (Anuppur district) and flows west to the Arabian Sea. It is called the lifeline of MP.
नर्मदा नदी को मध्य प्रदेश की जीवन रेखा कहा जाता है।

questions.q: The Narmada river originates from:
questions.solution:
The Narmada originates at Amarkantak in the Maikal range. (Janapav near Mhow is the origin of the Chambal.)
नर्मदा का उद्गम अमरकंटक से होता है।

questions.q: The Khajuraho group of temples was built by which dynasty?
questions.solution:
The Khajuraho temples (Chhatarpur district) were built by the Chandela rulers. They are a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
खजुराहो मंदिरों का निर्माण चंदेल शासकों ने करवाया।

questions.q: The Great Stupa at Sanchi was originally commissioned by:
questions.solution:
Emperor Ashoka commissioned the original Sanchi Stupa (Raisen district) in the 3rd century BCE.
सांची स्तूप का निर्माण मूल रूप से सम्राट अशोक ने करवाया।

questions.q: The Bhimbetka rock shelters are located in which district?
questions.solution:
Bhimbetka, famous for prehistoric rock paintings, is in Raisen district. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
भीमबेटका शैलाश्रय रायसेन जिले में हैं।

questions.q: What is the state animal of Madhya Pradesh?
questions.solution:
The Barasingha (hard-ground swamp deer) is the state animal of MP. It is best seen in Kanha National Park.
बारहसिंगा मध्य प्रदेश का राजकीय पशु है।

questions.q: Ujjain is situated on the banks of which river?
questions.solution:
Ujjain lies on the Kshipra (Shipra) river. The Simhastha Kumbh is held here.
उज्जैन क्षिप्रा नदी के तट पर स्थित है।

questions.q: Which important line of latitude passes through Madhya Pradesh?
questions.solution:
The Tropic of Cancer (23.5° N) passes through Madhya Pradesh and seven other Indian states.
कर्क रेखा मध्य प्रदेश से होकर गुजरती है।

questions.q: Fundamental Rights are given in which Part of the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:
Part III (Articles 12–35) contains the Fundamental Rights. Part IV contains the Directive Principles.
मौलिक अधिकार संविधान के भाग 3 में हैं।

questions.q: What is the SI unit of electric current?
questions.solution:
The SI unit of electric current is the ampere (A). Volt measures potential difference, ohm measures resistance and watt measures power.
विद्युत धारा का SI मात्रक एम्पियर है।

questions.q: What is the chemical formula of common salt?
questions.solution:
Common salt is sodium chloride, NaCl. Na₂CO₃ is washing soda and NaHCO₃ is baking soda.
साधारण नमक का रासायनिक सूत्र NaCl है।

questions.q: Which organelle is known as the 'powerhouse of the cell'?
questions.solution:
Mitochondria produce energy in the form of ATP through cellular respiration.
माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया को कोशिका का पावरहाउस कहा जाता है।

questions.q: Which of the following is an input device?
questions.solution:
A keyboard sends data into the computer, so it is an input device. Monitor, printer and speaker are output devices.
कीबोर्ड एक इनपुट डिवाइस है।

questions.q: 1 kilobyte (KB) is equal to:
questions.solution:
In computer memory, 1 KB = 1024 bytes (2¹⁰ bytes).
1 किलोबाइट = 1024 बाइट।

questions.q: Find the next number: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.solution:
Differences are 4, 6, 8, 10, so the next difference is 12: 30 + 12 = 42. (The pattern is n × (n+1).)
अंतर 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 बढ़ रहा है, इसलिए उत्तर 42 है।

questions.q: If CAT is coded as DBU, how is DOG coded?
questions.solution:
Each letter moves one place forward: D→E, O→P, G→H, so DOG = EPH.
हर अक्षर एक स्थान आगे बढ़ता है: DOG = EPH।

questions.q: Choose the synonym of 'ABUNDANT':
questions.solution:
Abundant means existing in large quantities, the same as plentiful. Scarce and rare are antonyms.
Abundant का अर्थ है 'प्रचुर / भरपूर'।
